proof_body:
by
  intro ι s x y mx my Vx Vy C r hs hVx0 hVy0 hmx hmy hVx hVy hC hr
  have hp : 0 < Real.sqrt Vx * Real.sqrt Vy := mul_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hVx0) (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hVy0)
  have cs : (∑ i ∈ s, (x i - mx) * (y i - my)) ^ 2 ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, (x i - mx) ^ 2) * ∑ i ∈ s, (y i - my) ^ 2 := Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq s _ _
  have hC2 : C ^ 2 ≤ Vx * Vy := by
    rw [hC, hVx, hVy, div_pow, div_mul_div_comm, ← sq]
    gcongr
  rw [hr, abs_div, abs_of_pos hp, div_le_one hp, ← Real.sqrt_mul hVx0.le]
  exact Real.abs_le_sqrt hC2
target_source: ∀ (ι : Type*) (s : Finset ι) (x y : ι → ℝ) (mx my Vx Vy C r : ℝ), s.Nonempty → 0 < Vx → 0 < Vy → mx = (∑ i ∈ s, x i) / s.card → my = (∑ i ∈ s, y i) / s.card → Vx = (∑ i ∈ s, (x i - mx) ^ 2) / s.card → Vy = (∑ i ∈ s, (y i - my) ^ 2) / s.card → C = (∑ i ∈ s, (x i - mx) * (y i - my)) / s.card → r = C / (Real.sqrt Vx * Real.sqrt Vy) → |r| ≤ 1
